wormed.definition: Form of worm (participle past): To make (one's way) with a crawling motion.

worms.definition: Form of worm (plural): A generally tubular invertebrate of the annelid phylum; an earthworm.

worn.definition: Form of wear (participle past): To have on.

worn-out.definition: Damaged due to continued or hard exposure or use until no longer effective or useful.

worried.definition: Form of worry (participle past): To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worry.definition: To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worrying.definition: Form of worry (gerund participle present): To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

worst.definition: Superlative form of bad: most bad.

worsted.definition: Yarn made from long strands of wool.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wound.definition: Form of wind (participle past): To blow air through a wind instrument or horn to make a sound.

wounded.definition: Form of wound (participle past): To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

wrath.definition: Great anger; (countable) an instance of this.

wrathful.definition: Possessed of great wrath; very angry.

wrathfully.definition: In a wrathful manner; with anger; angrily.

wreck.definition: Something or someone that has been ruined.

wrestling.definition: Form of wrestle (gerund participle present): To take part in (a wrestling bout or match).

wretched.definition: Characterized by or feeling deep affliction or distress; very miserable.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writer.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writer’s.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writes.definition: Form of write (indicative present singular third-person): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

written.definition: Form of write (participle past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrong-headedness.definition: Form of wrongheadedness (alternative): The state of being wrongheaded.

wrongly.definition: In violation of a moral or other standard, code, or convention; in an unfair, unjust, dishonest, or immoral manner; wrongly convicted is synonymous with wrongful conviction and miscarriage of justice.

wrongs.definition: Form of wrong (plural): Something that is immoral or not good.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrought.definition: Form of work (archaic participle past rare): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

wyandottes.definition: Form of wyandotte (plural): A member of the Wyandotte people.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yards.definition: Form of yard (plural): A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yawn.definition: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

yawned.definition: Form of yawn (participle past): To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

ye.definition: The Cyrillic letter Е, е, featured in various Slavic and Turkic languages.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yell.definition: To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yessir.definition: Term of address to a male; mate; buddy.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

younger.definition: Form of young (comparative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zoo.definition: A park where live animals are exhibited.
